newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPSM hits new high after positive forecast.
newsitem.headline: BPSM hits new high after positive forecast.

text.p: Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) rose 78 escudos to reach a new record high of 2,377 as recent positive forecasts by analysts continued to boost the stock.
"The outlook for BPSM is very good and the market is talking about 3,000 escudos as the price target for the end of the year," said one trader.
BPSM recently posted first-half consolidated net profits of 8.37 billion escudos, up sharply from 2.83 billion in the same period last year.

Analysts believe the share has room to rise to around 3,000 escudos provided the bank does not change its policy on extraordinary provisions for pension funds during the second half. Full-year results are not due until February next year.
By 1030 GMT BPSM shares had retreated slightly and were up 62 escudos at 2,361 on volume of 203,057.
